verdict.rationale: Zoho Books' own API docs state the parity goal directly: the REST API lets you "perform all the operations that you do with our web client", with every resource exposed as a URL. Broad endpoint coverage backs this up across contacts, organizations, settings copying, banking, reconciliation and bank rules, and the docs link a downloadable full OpenAPI corpus. The 404s on generic OpenAPI paths do not contradict that docs-linked spec. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on verification that parity holds in practice, and evidence that UI features such as Zia AI, workflow Blueprints and 1099 e-filing are reachable through the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
